crop.definition:
n. the yield from plants in a single growing season
n. a cultivated plant that is grown commercially on a large scale
n. a collection of people or things appearing together
n. the output of something in a season
crop.translation:
n. 农作物, 产量, 平头
vt. 收割, 修剪, 种植
vi. 收获
[计] 裁剪

crop duster.translation: n. 喷撒杀虫剂的飞行员; 撒农药飞机, 喷撒杀虫剂的飞机

crop out.translation: 突然发生, 出现, 露头

crop-dust.translation: v. 撒农药(尤指由飞机撒播), 从事撒农药的工作

crop-dusting.definition: n. the dispersion of fungicides or insecticides or fertilizer on growing crops (often from a low-flying aircraft)

crop-ear.definition: n. A person or animal whose ears are cropped.
crop-ear.translation: n. 耳朵剪有记号的马(或狗), 有剪记的耳朵

crop-eared.translation: a. 剪去耳朵尖的, 剪短头发露出耳朵的

crop-full.translation: a. 填满肚子的, 满腹的

crop-over.translation: n. 甘蔗收割结束后的狂欢

crop-sprayer.translation:
农作物喷雾机
大田喷雾机

crop-sprayers.translation:
(crop-sprayer 的复数) 农作物喷雾机
大田喷雾机

crop-yield.translation: 粮食产量, 作物产量；谷物收获量

crop-yields.translation: (crop-yield 的复数) 粮食产量, 作物产量；谷物收获量

cropful.translation:
cropful (comparative more cropful, superlative most cropful)
Having a full crop or belly; satiated.


cropful (plural cropfuls)
Enough to fill the crop of a bird.

cropless.translation: 无庄稼的, 无农作物的
